His feeling is right: the burn feels like ~100M an hour because it is. VERIFIED DONE: AGENTS-ULTIMATE.md (11,040 B, 09:25) + THE-OFFICIAL-PARTS.md (10,720 B, 09:37); slim briefs per the Layered Context Law (maker ~5K, checker ~3K, eye ~2K); diff-based checkers (the fix-1e checker read 65/−30 lines); whole-list rounds (fix-1e, 12 items, one round). VERIFIED NOT DONE: the captain's own wake still loads the FULL ~/MEMORY.md (897,681 B) + ~/AGENTS.md (249,069 B) — ~288K tokens before any work, the biggest burn slice, and the distilled file existing does not stop the injection (a system change, not a file edit); eyes still took dozens of screenshots (85 in one Round 2 eye) against the 12 rule; loops still run on the clock (PI refresh 15 min, VPM hourly); the Dashboard token pie (ordered 09:10) is still not built on the Dashboard (chat widgets only). The optimizations slowed the burn; they did not stop it.
